prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='CWT_catboost', seasonality_champion='ARIMA', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: CWT_catboost achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ARIMA leads seasonality capture (0.5214), but ONLY_FT_rf dominates overall RMSE (379.16). High model disagreement (rmse_spread_ratio=38.16) and seasonality variance (0.941) combined with concept drift detection suggest STL-hierarchical stacking to exploit decomposition-aware combination. Early/late horizon specialists differ (FT_catboost vs CWT_rf), supporting per-horizon or decomposition-based weighting.
